 5.1-magnitude quake hits Mindanao, Philippines - GFZ
 14 November 2026 22:11 (UTC +04:00) 
 An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.1 jolted Mindanao, Philippines at 1604 GMT on Saturday, the GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences said, Xinhua reports.
 The epicenter, with a depth of 137.6 km, was initially determined to be at 8.45 degrees north latitude and 126.30 degrees east longitude.
